outcome: Unplanned health care utilization (emergency department visits, unscheduled clinic visits, hospital readmission)
cohort: The study included 1,441 patients with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, or chronic hypertension) from a single academic center.
finding: Expedited discharge after delivery in patients with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy was not associated with a higher rate of unplanned healthcare utilization postpartum, though it was associated with higher attendance at 1-2 week postpartum blood pressure checks.
